publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: A hybrid method by combining probabilistic neural network (PNN) with linear discriminant analysis (LDA) for face recognition is proposed in this paper. At the first place, the LDA method is employed to reduce the dimensions of sample feature, and then a PNN method is adopted for solving the problems of face recognition. The proposed method not only saves computing time of the whole implementation, but also improves computing efficiency and precision of the hybird algorithm. Experimental simulation results indicate that the LDA-PNN method gets a good performance in classification in handling the standard databases.

articleTitle: Training system for operation of dialysis puncture in clinical engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: As a professional clinic engineer, he needs to learn a large amount of theoretical knowledge and operation skills for different medical machines. However, it is known that a total mastering of so large amount of knowledge and skills are difficult only by studying in university within a limited time. For helping the student towards the clinic engineer, a training system with information communication was proposed in this study. In the proposed system, a few of the most popular problems a clinic engineer may meet in hospital when operating practical medical machines were selected, studied and some solutions for related training methods were suggested. As a typical example, the training system used for dialysis puncture technique in hemodialysis was firstly selected. In more detail, an arm model and a simulation circuit for dialysis operation were produced. The operations upon several skilled clinical engineers were recorded and their movements were quantitatively extracted to form suitable indexes for the evaluation of training effects. By using the system with puncture operation exercise mostly similar to the practical ones over human bodies, it is possible for the students to get a deeper understanding upon the holding style of the needle, the tracks and angles of dialysis puncture by doing repeatable practices with real-timely evaluation on each operation practice.

articleTitle: Locally adaptive image denoising of “The first satellite of high resolution” image based on generalized Gaussian distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: An adaptive statistical model for wavelet image coefficients was presented based on exploiting the correlations among the image wavelet decomposition coefficients in a subband, and applied to the image denoising of Remote Sensing Image. Each wavelet coefficient was firstly modeled as a random variable of a generalized Gaussian distribution (GGD), then, based on the algorithm of the wavelet soft threshold denoising and according to the characteristics of spatial clustering of wavelet decomposition coefficients, a new local adaptive algorithm was proposed and applied to restore the noisy images by estimate the coefficients with maximum posteriori probability rule (MAP). The algorithm was applied to denoise the noisy Remote Sensing Image of “The first satellite of high resolution”. Simulation results showed that the higher peak-signal to noise ratio and the better visual effects were obtained as compared to other image denoising methods.

Author Keywords: The first satellite of high resolution

articleTitle: On utilization of k-means for determination of q-parameter for tsallis-entropy-maximized-FCM
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this article, we consider a combinatorial algorithm of fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering maximized with the Tsallis entropy and the deterministic annealing method. The Tsallis entropy is determined as a q-parameter extension of the Shannon entropy. Membership functions similar to statistical mechanical distribution functions have been derived by maximizing the Tsallis entropy within the framework of FCM. One of the major issues when using this method is, it is still unknown how to determine an appropriate q value and the initial or highest annealing temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">high</sub>) for a given data set. Accordingly, in this article, we present a new method that determines these values simultaneously without introducing any additional parameters. In our method, the membership function is simplified by approximating by a high-temperature series expansion method and the k-means clustering algorithm is utilized as a preprocessing step to estimate a radius of each cluster. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method is effective, and both q and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">high</sub> can be determined automatically, algebraically and properly for a given data set.

articleTitle: An improved sampling K-means clustering algorithm based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The parallel sampling K-means algorithm can improve the performance and accuracy of clustering, but there are still some problems to be settled, such as samples sensitivity to the initial clustering center and the clustering effect stability. In this paper, an improved parallel sampling K-means clustering algorithm is proposed. First, the sampling from the big data is parallelized in the new algorithm. Second, k′ points are selected randomly from the sample and singular points among them are removed, and k points are obtained for sample clustering. Finally, the matrix of all sample cluster centers is generated and a row of the matrix is selected randomly as initial center to cluster again to get initial cluster center for big data set. The experiment results demonstrate that the improved sampling K-means clustering algorithm has good accuracy and stability for big data clustering.

articleTitle: Semi-orthogonal wavelets of space L2[0, 1] and fast wavelet algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)

articleTitle: Multilingual and skew license plate detection based on extremal regions
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: License Plate Detection (LPD) is an important component of many applications involving security and traffic surveillance. Despite current progress, lots of hurdles remain in the way of a robust LPD system. This is particularly true for the detection of license plates with different layouts and skew angles. In this paper, a novel LPD system is proposed for detecting English and Chinese license plates with large skew angles. The proposed system consists of three main stages: 1) a character proposal module to find candidate characters based on Extremal Regions (ERs); 2) feature extraction and classification relies on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN); 3) license plate detection by region linking. The new method much improves on the robustness of existing approaches by leaving out character segmentation. The performance of the proposed license plate localization algorithm is verified using different datasets of vehicle images, including a large field-captured dataset, a skew and tilt dataset, a 12 countries dataset and two benchmark datasets. For Chinese civilian vehicles, the accuracy of plate localization is over 98.3%.

articleTitle: A recommendation algorithm based on density peak clustering and key users
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: At present, the research on recommendation algorithm is limited to how to improve the existing algorithm or design new algorithm, blindly pursue the accuracy and diversity of the recommended results, rarely study the importance of the individual user in the recommendation system, but study the importance of the individual user in the recommendation system can improve the recommendation efficiency and enhance the robustness of the recommendation system. Aiming at this problem, the key users determination method based on density peak clustering is proposed, which can effectively distinguish the key users of the recommendation system. Furthermore, the recommendation algorithm based on density peak clustering and key users is proposed. The proposed algorithm is efficient through experimental verification, which not only improves the recommendation efficiency, but also improves the recommendation accuracy and diversity.

articleTitle: Estimation of heat flux distribution in convective heat transfer system based on decentralized fuzzy inference
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper studies the use of finite element method (FEM) and decentralized fuzzy inference method (DFIM) to realize the identification problem of heat flux density of two-dimensional steady convection heat system. Establishing a set of fuzzy inference unit, according to the measured values of the temperature deviation and the calculated values of the dispersion of fuzzy reasoning, a set of fuzzy inference components is obtained. Finally, through a comprehensive weighted fuzzy reasoning component, the compensation amount of heat flux density can be received. Through numerical experiments, the effects of initial guess value, temperature measuring points and measurement errors on the results are discussed, and the results of conjugate gradient method (CGM) are compared. The results show that compared with CGM, DFIM reduces the inversion results of measurement points and the number of initial guess value depending on measurement error, and enhances the anti-interference ability, which has better anti-ill ability.

articleTitle: Prediction of distribution network malfunction based on meteorological factors
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Distribution network malfunction often causes serious economic losses and social negative impact. If we can effectively predict the numbers of distribution network malfunction, it would provide reliable data basis for the promptly maintenance and power repair. In this paper, three kinds of analysis algorithms, stepwise regression analysis, zero-inflated Poisson regression and support vector regression (SVR), are used to fit the numbers of malfunction. We utilized the lightning data and meteorological factors as independent variables, and utilized the external malfunctions and natural malfunctions as the dependent variables to establish the prediction models. At the end of this paper, the accuracy of these three methods is discussed. The relative root mean square error(R-RMSE) of each prediction method is calculated. We found that the external malfunctions using support SVR to obtain the best results, and natural malfunctions are better with the zero-inflated Poisson regression model.

articleTitle: A modified MOEA/D by introducing an invasive weed optimization operator
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Decomposition (MOEA/D) is a representative multi-objective optimization (MOO) algorithm. Recently, some researchers proposed several modification versions of MOEA/D to improve the performance on the benchmark test problems suggested in CEC'09. This paper proposes a modified invasive weed optimization (IWO) operator and introduced it into two modification versions of MOEA/D. When the generation is divisible by certain number, the modified IWO operator rather than Differential Evolutionary (DE) operator is implemented to generate new individuals. And updating the individuals by using the modified IWO operator has a little different from the original IWO operator, the new individuals will be compared with their parent individuals firstly, then perform the original update method. Experimental results of 10 unconstrained problems proposed in CEC'09 show that the performance of the proposed algorithm has an improvement for some of the test problems.

articleTitle: Reducing inverse quantization numbers for video transcoding
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, a complexity-quality analysis with transcoding architectures is proposed for reduced inverse quantization numbers. This architecture is different from conventional transcoding scheme, which neglects the relation between first and second quantized step size. However, our proposed transcoding architecture depends on the modulus of the ratio of second quantization and first quantization parameter. By analyzing quantized area of first quantization and second quantization parameter, we concluded the part of undoing first inverse quantization, to reduce computing complexity. From computer simulation we verify the merits of the proposed scheme over the conventional transcoding approaches, in terms of achieving better performance based on the computing complexity and objective (e.g., the peak signal-to-noise ratio) analysis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy approach to fatigue problems in composite materials and structures
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: For composites static strength, fatigue damage and durability demonstrate a scatter factor of results larger than for isotropic materials. To characterize it the fuzzy set approach is proposed. Two different mechanical descriptions of fatigue life are used in order to describe the uncertainty and randomness of parameters characterizing the fatigue damage and finally the fatigue durability. The theoretical predictions representing the lower and upper bounds of a fatigue life are compared with experimental data. In general, the present analysis shows that the fuzzy set description allows us to take into account much more parameters than classical deterministic or statistical methods.

articleTitle: Photographic composite detection using scene perspective constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Photographic composite is a common image forgery which inserts visually plausible composite into target image. However, the size relationship of multiple objects in real world might be distorted since it is difficult to insert a foreign object into the target image with proper size. To detect photographic composite forgery, a blind detection approach is proposed by exploiting scene perspective constraint. It determines the height ratio of two objects in an image without any knowledge of camera parameters. That is, the height ratio is found merely by the planar homography of reference plane on which both objects of interest are situated and the vanishing point of the direction perpendicular to the reference plane. If the relationship of relative size is not appropriate, candidate image is identified as a forged image. Experiment results prove that the proposed method is effective, even when candidate images have been down-sampled or compressed with a low quality factor.

articleTitle: Fuzzy set ordination analysis of survival communities for an endangered medicinal plant species, Phellodendron amurense
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Fuzzy set ordination is based on fuzzy mathematical theory and is attractive for ecologists for it directly incorporates the environmental gradients into the calculation of ordination scores. Fuzzy set ordination was applied to study ecological relations of survival communities for an endangered medicinal tree species, Phellodendron amurense, in the Xiaolongmen Forest Park, Beijing. The data sets consist of abundance values of 89 plant species and 6 environmental variables in 25 quadrats. The results showed that fuzzy set ordination successfully displayed quadrats in species space related to environmental gradients. The distribution of quadrats and community types on FSO ordination plot was fully interpreted. Altitude and litter thickness were key factors influencing community composition and structure. These relationships must be considered in conservation of P. amurense populations and communities.

articleTitle: Optimization of hydraulic calculation simulation based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Gas pipeline network is usually composed of branch network and loop network of multiple sources. The hydraulic calculation model and the finite element method are used to analyze the main causes of the deviation between hydraulic calculation results and actual measured values. Based on genetic algorithm, the adaptive simulation system of hydraulic calculation on gas network is developed. Using the measured data, the system can identify the parameters of the hydraulic model, and can dynamically adjust unknown node flow and pipeline capacity factor. The simulation results and the measured data are consistent with a certain precision. It can effectively analyze the operating conditions and accident conditions of gas network. The system ensures optimum operation and safe gas supply of gas network.

articleTitle: Formal transforming approach of spatiotemporal data from XML to object-oriented database
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the popularity of XML applications, XML becomes the mainstream and the de-facto standard of information exchange and coding format. Since object-oriented (OO) database has a stronger ability to store data, many commercial data are stored in object-oriented database and the applications of object-oriented database are more and more wide. Consequently, it is significant to exchange data from XML to object-oriented database. Meanwhile, there are a lot of spatiotemporal data in real applications, which should be transformed from XML to object-oriented database, by means of combining the characteristics of XML and object-oriented database. In this paper, we propose the methodologies of transforming spatiotemporal data from XML to object-oriented database. In particular, in order to describe spatiotemporal XML DTD, we study the object-oriented schema. Furthermore, we focus on mapping functions and rules for the transformation.

articleTitle: Load forecast based on least square SVR and HHT
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Load forecast provides a decision-making basis for scheduling system of power system, synchronous control, operate plan and development program. To achieve high-accuracy of load forecast, many scholars are trying many methods. But the non-stationary, volatile and nonlinear properties of load data makes it much harder for precise load forecast. In this paper a load forecast method is proposed, which is based on least squares support vector regression (LSSVR), an evolutive version of standard support vector regression, and Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT). This method firstly decomposed the load data to several sub-level data with clear tendency by HHT. Then these sub-level data are forecasted with LSSVR respectively. At last these results were recomposed as the forecast output of the original load data. The appropriate emulation of above forecast model were checked based on some sample data.

articleTitle: Face alignment based on improved shape searching
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Accurate face alignment is a vital step for most face perception tasks. In this paper, we proposed a new approach based on improved face shape searching for face alignment. It begins with a shape space that contains diverse shapes. Unlike previous shape searching method that processes its every shape searching in the whole sample space, our method first train the random forest classifiers by training samples and partition the whole shape space into multiple sub-spaces, and then we process our shape searching in sub-spaces. Finally, we employ cascaded regression to achieve face alignment. Our method demonstrates its obvious decreases in searching time and its good robustness in unconstrained environment on three challenging datasets.

articleTitle: Real-time messaging and time-shifted communication wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper relates to a device pairing algorithm and information exchange, which enable establishment of communications between plural entities and facilitate the exchange of messages between customers (e.g., customers) and service providers (e.g., servers). This communication system also defines a set of messages captured and stored on database servers for later reference and analytics. Such communication services enable mobile devices to pair and communicate in either real-time or time-shifted mode where pairing requests and messages are retrieved and progressively rendered from data storage. Device pairing and message dispatching are routed progressively as they are transmitted to a recipient device or data servers that store pairing requests and messages. The uniqueness of the model is the communication system driving the messaging platform where the client communication devices are programmable devices, such as mobile and desktop computers, capable of running the communication application.

articleTitle: Product defects detection based on features fusion and the multi-scale sliding window
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to improve the detection accuracy and real-time performance of the product surface quality, we present a method of machine vision on the basis of features fusion and the multi-scale sliding window. The proposed method can be divided into the training phase and the detection phase. In the training phase, firstly, the HOG features and HSV features of the image are extracted, then the both extracted features are fused using the RBF neural network. Next, Least Squares Support Vector Machine(Ls-SVM) is used to train the fused features for generating a defects classifier. For most products, the precision requirement of the different surfaces is different, so the multiscale sliding window is generated in the detection phase to improve the detection quality effectively. According to the proposed scale division criteria, first of all, the features extraction and fusion are implemented in different-scale windows. Then matched with the template in the above trained classifier, thus obtaining the detection result finally. Experimental results show that the proposed method has a significant improvement in detection accuracy and real-time, compared with the traditional detection method.

articleTitle: Application of Powell fruit fly optimization algorithm to solutions of nonlinear equations
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Solution to nonlinear equations is with extensive practical meanings in engineering. The convergence of classic numerical solutions is dependent on the initial value which is actually hard to be determined in actual computation. Thus, a new solution to nonlinear equations called PFOA is put forward to turn the complicated solution to nonlinear equations to function optimization. Group search and global convergence of the fruit fly optimization algorithm (FOA) can be fully utilized via PFOA, thereby effectively overcoming the initial point sensitivity of Powell. However, positive local optimal solution can be realized by Powell, so the two algorithms are improved effectively along with integration and complementation in this paper. Five typical nonlinear equations are selected, and the calculation results show the designed PFOA is superior to the basic FOA and is considered a successful solution to nonlinear equations.

articleTitle: Decomposition of Petri nets based on the behavior relation matrix
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: To simplify the Petri net analysis, the decomposition technique is attracting more attention. Existing decomposition techniques mostly consider the structure, do not involve process behavior. In this article we present a new decomposition algorithm of Petri net with process behaviors. The behavior relation matrix is proposed in the paper. If elements of behavior relation matrix belongs to the same relation class, many problems (like matrix decomposition, Petri net decomposition problem) can be solved in a polynomial time. A Free-Choice Petri net can get only one behavior relation matrix, and the behavior relation matrix of a Free-Choice Petri net can be decomposed uniquely. And the whole decomposition process turns to be polynomial. An Workflow net and an Ada net as two experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed idea.

articleTitle: Inversion about heat flux with phase change process in molten material reactor based on fuzzy adaptive prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: For phase change heat transfer process of a molten material reactor, the boundary heat flux is inversed with a fuzzy adaptive predictive inverse method (FAPIM). The time-varying prediction model of measurement temperatures is formed and the heat flux is inversed with temperature measurement information in the next period of time by rolling optimization. Considering the nonlinear of the phase change process, this paper uses a decentralized fuzzy inference (DFI) mechanism to update the influence relationship matrix. A set of fuzzy inference units are formed to make decentralized inference, so the predictive model can be adaptive online. The effects of future time steps r and temperature measurement error on the inverse results are analyzed by numerical experiments. The validity of the inverse scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Abnormal condition diagnosis for process industry based on virtual sensing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Both process changes and sensor faults can result in the unexpected deviation of the sensor reading from its anticipated values. When the anomaly of sensor measurement occurs, in order to take appropriate actions to diminish or eliminate related dangerous factors, identifying the source of abnormal conditions is a very crucial step. To reach that, an abnormal condition diagnosis method based on virtual sensing technology is proposed. Once the abnormal situation of sensor measurement is detected, the virtual sensor is constructed based on the Gauss Process Regression and Moving Windows algorithm. Through analyzing prediction residual, the task of differentiating between sensor and system faults can be performed. In order to verify the performance of this proposal, a case study is carried out on CSTH platform, where both scenarios of sensor faults and process changes are considered. The simulation results show the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional video inpainting using gradient fusion and clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: For the foreground and background segmentation in Three-Dimensional(3D) video inpainting, the inaccuracy of the foreground extraction will easily affect the quality of the repaired image. In order to solve this problem, this paper combines watershed algorithm with marker for foreground extraction, making full use of the structural information of the depth image. In order to enhance the ability of distinguishing the foreground object, introducing K-means clustering to mark it in the gradient image. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm overcomes the defect of original watershed algorithm in image segmentation, which is likely to occur the over-segmentation phenomenon, and it also can completely extract the texture information of the foreground object, making the repaired image have better visual effect, and the peak signal-to-noise ratio(PSNR) is increased by 1 to 3 dB, compared to the other algorithm.

articleTitle: Resource scheduling strategy in consistency-based information-centric networking
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, the information of Information-Centric Networking (ICN) based on the information consistency is classified and stored according to the classification standard. Then the resources in ICN are divided by the classification standard to calculate the category popularity. Afterward, combining the 0-1 knapsack model with the dynamic programming algorithm, we design the 0-1 knapsack resource scheduling strategy based on the category popularity. At last, the simulation experiments illustrate the rationality and superiority of resource scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal context tracking with color attributes
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Distinguishing and tracking moving object is one of the most critical tasks in computer vision. A tracker with high speed and precision is required in the real-world object tracking. The correlation filtering tracking approaches have attracted much attention because of its high-speed and robustness. Spatio-Temporal Context (STC) tracker exploits the context information around the target, and improves the tracking performance. For further improving the efficiency and robustness, in the paper, we propose to construct the object appearance using color attributes in STC tracker. Color attributes can be computed efficiently and possess high discriminative power. Experiment results demonstrate that the spatio-temporal context tracker with color attributes can obtain superior performance in real-world tracking.

articleTitle: Pressure casting control for thin-walled parts based on dynamic matrix control
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Aims at the control of the complex MIMO pure delay coupled pressure casting system, a TY-3 type computer control system was made by tracking the ideal dynamic pressure curve by computer during the whole process of casting parts. Firstly, the model of the 2 inputs and 2 outputs casting system was built using least square identification combined theoretical analysis. Secondly, three algorithms including self-tuning PID, dynamic matrix control (DMC), PID plus DMC (PID+DMC) were exerted to the control of upper container pressure and lower container pressure in casting system in different situation. And their robustness was also analyzed. Via comparison and analysis, the results show that the PID plus DMC method has most desirable dynamic performance in overshoot, settling time and has the strongest robustness when model mismatch occurred.

articleTitle: A new supervised image classification using data set partition
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Random vector functional-link net (RVFL) is a single hidden layer network and extreme learning machine (ELM) is its special case with making weights from the output to the input be zero. RVFL (or ELM) and sparse representation classifier classification approach, called RVFLSRC or ELMSRC one, was an efficient hybrid model to balance between the time and the accuracy of classification. However, the classification time of RVFLSRC is still long. Besides, some images are wrongly classified by sparse representation classifier in RVFLSRC, which degrades the performance of RVFLSRC. In order to improve the recognition rate and reduce the classification time, we propose a new supervised image classification using data set partition (SIC-SP). In SIC-SP, we introduce a formula to estimate the number of images being divided wrongly by RVFLSRC (or ELMSRC), which are used to compute the division threshold. Using that division threshold can reduce the number of images being divided wrongly by RVFLSRC to improve the classification accuracy and reduce the classification time. In addition, we use principal component analysis to reduce the sample dimension, which also shortens the classification time. Experimental results on USPS handwritten digit database and UMIST face one show that the classification time of our SIC-SP is only 1/224 of classification time of SRC, and 1/30 of classification time of ELMSRC (or RVFLSRC). Meanwhile, the classification accuracy of SIC-SP is 97.62% on USPS, and 99.27% on UMIST, higher than those of ELM (or RVFL), SRC, and ELMSRC (or RVFLSRC).

articleTitle: The application of fuzzy probability in assessment of pure electric vehicle battery system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the purpose of assessing the health status of battery in the process of charging and discharging. A lithium iron phosphate battery as example, through each monomer in weighing the battery voltage to the influence of the overall battery system to make this clear. First using the method of the fuzzy probability to evaluate each monomer voltage state of health; Then the application of the fuzzy relationship synthetic to evaluate the lithium iron phosphate batteries overall health status; At last, complete the assessment to the health status of battery system effectively, combining with the variation coefficient method to assign weights on the basis of expert scoring evaluation.

articleTitle: Block dictionary learning with l0 regularization and its application in image denoising
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Dictionary learning is aimed to learn a set of basic elements termed as atoms from a given training set, and these atoms form a dictionary. In this paper, we propose a block dictionary learning algorithm, called Mini-batch K-sparse Dictionary Learning (MKDL), by directly optimizing a K-sparse problem under the mini-batch setting. At each iteration of MKDL, only small-batch training samples are used to sparse coding and dictionary update stages. Particularly, iterative hard thresholding and projected gradient descent schemes are employed to optimize the two above-mentioned stages, respectively. Preliminary results on image denoising have much better performance than previous dictionary learning algorithms, which validates the effectiveness of our approach in convergence speed and denoising quality.

articleTitle: A feature optimization algorithm of concept similarity based on Chinese wikipedia
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Concept similarity measure based on feature vector has wide application in various fields, but the problems of polysemy and synonym existing in feature vector affect the similarity measure. We present a feature optimization algorithm based on Chinese Wikipedia which can reduces this effect. First we build a POS feature dictionary (POS-Dic) and a POS Tongyici Cilin(POS-Cilin), and then a new feature vector is used for concept similarity measure. Experiments show that the algorithm effectively reduces the influence of polysemy and synonym on the concept similarity measure.

articleTitle: Observers of control state and uncertainty using Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Adding a term called uncertainty in the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model to cover the difference between a real system concerned and its T-S fuzzy model, this paper proposes novel observers of the control state and the uncertainty. Unlike state observer in the traditional sense that is usually designed as a whole, following dividing the state into two parts by performing a unique matrix transformation, two observers of the state are designed separately in order to eliminate the influence of the uncertainty. Finally, an observer of the uncertainty based on one of state observers is provided.

articleTitle: An accurate and efficient face recognition method based on hash coding
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: To improve the efficiency in face recognition with highdimension features extracted from deep model, a fast recognition method based on hash coding is proposed. Different from others, the hash coding and the cascade network are designed for a two-stage face recognition. Firstly, the low-dimensional and high-dimensional features are extracted according to different models. Secondly, the low-dimensional features are quantized into hash codes by a piecewise function. And then, the first-identify is completed by calculating hamming distance between the hash codes. Finally, the second-identify is completed by calculating cosine distance between the high-dimensional features of face images after the first-identify. The experimental results show that the method proposed can improve the Rank-1 recognition efficiency up to 64% while the accuracy is the same as VGG.

articleTitle: Predictive control of superheated steam temperature based on decentralized fuzzy inference
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: A predictive control scheme based on decentralized fuzzy inference is developed for the control of superheater steam temperature. Firstly, the future output of the control object is predicted by the object's step response model. Then a decentralized fuzzy inference structure is designed. The deviations between the predicted and expected values in the future instant are regarded as inputs of fuzzy inference units to perform the fuzzy inference process and acquire the inference results. The inference results then are weighted and synthesized and the control output of the system is generated. Simulation results for the superheated steam temperature are presented to show the desired performance of the developed approach.

articleTitle: The improved detection of vehicle on the road for GF-2 satellite image with 1m spatial resolution
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, the image data of GF-2 is used. According to the results of vehicle detection using improved double threshold methods, it is found that there is a large false detection, and the false detection is mainly includes roadside shrub and lane line. Therefore, in order to enhance the accuracy of vehicle detection, this paper proposes to extract the lane line which is easy to be false detection by using the position feature and the edge feature. At the same time, the edge of the road is extracted by the location feature of shrub, and then the different texture feature between the false detection targets and the real targets are extracted. The fuzzy neural networks classifier is used to detect the vehicle targets in the sensitive area. The result shows that the accurate detection of the sensitive area and the use of the fuzzy neural networks can greatly reduce the false detection of the vehicle targets and enhance the accuracy of the double threshold vehicle detection method.

articleTitle: Fuzzy measures defined by pan-integral
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Considering a given pan-space (X, A,μ, R+,⊕, ⊗) and a given nonnegative measurable function f on (X, A), the pan-integral of f w.r.t μ and (⊕, ⊗) determines a new fuzzy measure v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> on (X, A). Such new fuzzy measure preserves some important structural characteristics of fuzzy measures, such as continuity from below, continuity from above, strong order continuity, autocontinuity, null-additivity, subadditivity and the pseudometric generating property, etc. Since the pan-integral based on a pair of pan-operations (⊕, ⊗) covers the Sugeno integral (based on (V, ∧)) while the Shilkret integral (based on (V, ·)), therefore, the previous related results for the Sugeno integral are covered by the results presented here, in the meantime, we obtain some special results related the Shilkret integral.

articleTitle: Remotely checking data integrity with high efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Public verification is the main technique for remotely checking data integrity, which ensures that the storage server stores the outsourced data correctly. However, there remain several security and efficiency issues with current bilinear-map-based public verification schemes. First, they are vulnerable to various attacks if deployed improperly, which shows their security needs to be further analyzed. Second, current schemes employ two modular exponentiation operations in their signing algorithm, which will put a heavy burden on data publishers when signing a lot of data blocks. Third, the computation cost on verifying server's side depends on the number of data blocks, which is not suitable for verifying a variety of data blocks. To address these issues, this paper classifies the design goals, details the system and attack models, and proposes an optimized public verification scheme with privacy-preserving.

articleTitle: An optimization model of outpatient appointment scheduling window with patient no-show
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper is to investigate appointment system of an outpatient department in a large hospital in China-West China Hospital (WCH). Through survey, the efficiency of appointment system could be improved by controlling scheduling window. Usually, setting a reasonable appointment scheduling window can reduce patient no-shows and improve outpatient departmental resource utilization. So, the paper studies the problem of outpatient appointment scheduling window considering patient no-show. In this paper, we applied the queuing theory to develop an M/M/1/N model. The objective is to minimize the patient waiting time and physician idle time. Through our analysis, we found out that the queuing model is quasi-concave, and by performing numerical experiments, we verify the effectiveness of the model and its proposition of quasi-concave.

articleTitle: A prototype simulator for the simulation of complicated hadoop framework behaviors
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Distributed computing and parallel computing have become the most effective tools for solving complex problems in amount of academia and industrial fields. Among a number of distributed and parallel computing technologies, MapReduce has been proved as one of the most efficient and reliable computing model to deal with distributed tasks. Especially, Hadoop framework, a Java based open source implementation of MapReduce has been widely used and studied. Hadoop supplies tremendously abilities to process large-scale tasks with large volume of data, which significantly facilitates the big data applications. However, Hadoop is lack of a function that to predict the job processing time before actually running a job. And also. Hadoop cannot tell that how the system performs under the condition that the system parameters have been tuned. Therefore, this paper presents a prototype Hadoop simulator which aims at simulating the parameters and interactions of the Hadoop framework using agent based simulation. The experimental results show that the simulator offers potentials to be an instrument to study complicated behaviors of the Hadoop framework.

articleTitle: Tensor optimal scoring for alzheimer's disease detection
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In recent years, the universal application of magnetic resonance imaging has given a new diagnostic approach for lots of diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD). In this paper, we propose a new classification framework for AD detection. To avoid the curse of dimensionality problem, a new dimension reduction algorithm in tensor space called tensor optimal scoring (TOS) was proposed to extract efficient features from MRI data of AD. Alternating least square optimization was employed to estimate the projection vector and optimal scores. We validated the effectiveness of our proposed method on OASIS dataset. The experimental results showed that our method outperformed the traditional methods especially for higher order MRI data.

articleTitle: Multi-class wine grades predictions with hierarchical support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Important wine attributes found in wine reviews are used to predict a wine's grade through linear kernel support vector machines (SVMs). In this work, grade prediction is defined as a multi-class problem with four classes: 100~95, 94~90, 89~85 and 84 below. Since SVMs inherently do binary classification, the multi-class problem is solved using a hierarchical approach. More than 100,000 wines are collected as our dataset. Based on the two-layer SVM model which is built in this study, we accomplish high accuracy on predicting a wine's grade. Coverage, which is usually a multi-label metric, is also adapted to evaluate these results. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first time that multi-class problem is applied to Wineinformatics.

articleTitle: HUNSPM: An efficient algorithm for mining high utility negative sequential patterns
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Recently, High Utility Sequential Patterns (HUSP) Mining plays more and more important role in many applications. However, the current HUSP mining algorithms only considers Positive Sequential Patterns (PSP), therefore limiting their ability to hand Negative Sequential Patterns (NSP). In some applications, NSP may bring more valuable information than PSP due to the absent elements. Although many algorithms have been proposed to mine NSP with frequency-based model, they are not suitable for mining NSP with utility-based model because an item in a NSP may have multiple utilities. In this paper, we introduce a new algorithm HUNSPM to identify high utility negative sequential patterns (HUNSP). HUNSPM consists of four major steps: (i) using traditional HUSP mining algorithms to mine all HUPSP; (ii) generating High Utility Negative Sequential Candidates (HUNSC) based on above mined HUPSP and storing all related information about HUNSC in the PNU-List; (iii) removing unpromising HUNSC and calculating the utility of promising HUNSC; (iv) getting all HUNSP. We have tired our best to indicate that HUNSPM is the first method to find NSP on the basis of minimum utility. The consequence of the experiment propose that the HUNSPM is efficient and highly effective.

articleTitle: Diffraction tomographic imaging algorithm for through-the-wall radar in planar multilayer environment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of imaging of concealed targets in planar multilayer environment, a novel diffraction tomographic (DT) imaging algorithm for through-the-wall radar (TWR) system is proposed in this paper. By exploiting the Born approximation (BA) theory, the spectral form of the Green function of the planar multilayered medium and exploding reflection model, the proposed DT imaging method can utilize the fast Fourier transform (FFT) technique to achieve the fast and accurate imaging reconstruction of targets hidden behind the multilayered wall. The imaging results reconstructed via the processing of synthetic data generated by finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method have verified the validity and effectiveness of the proposed imaging method.

articleTitle: Evolving GMDH-neuro-fuzzy system with small number of tuning parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In the paper a new class of evolving fuzzy networks is suggested, namely the evolving GMDH-neuro-fuzzy systems (Group Method of Data Handling). Their main advantage is a small number of tuning parameters that simplifies the training algorithms and cut training time comparing with classical evolving fuzzy neural networks (EFNN). The architecture and training algorithms for this neural network are considered. The experimental investigations of the proposed GMDH-neuro-fuzzy systems were carried out in the problem of stock prices forecasting and comparisons with GMDH algorithm and the cascade neuro-fuzzy network were performed that enable their efficiency estimation.

articleTitle: The hardware design of taxi smart terminals
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the hardware design method of taxi intelligent terminal. Using the embedded technology, the radio frequency IC technology, biometric identification technology, wireless communication technology, a dedicated taxi intelligent terminal was designed. The modular design is convenient for the user. Different choose has achieved different levels of management. The hardware mainly include control module, positioning module, wireless communication module, measurement module, display module, print module, voice module, RF module and driving record module and so on. The article involves a brief description of the relevant technology and device selection method, give each part principle, structure or circuit. Design completed intelligent terminals have a full-featured, high integration characteristics. The smart terminals can meet the requirement of traffic management department, rental companies, rental drivers and customers.

articleTitle: An automatic plotting method of air temperature isoline based on rectangular grids
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Contrary to the previous semi-supervised and complicated isoline drawing methods, we developed a real-time and low time complexity isoline method by the JAVA development language. Our method is based on the principle of computer automatic isoline drawing. The method meshes the air temperature observation into rectangular grids, then calculates points in each grid by the simply IDW interpolation algorithm. The method generates a isoline map for a region after calculating equivalent points, tracing and smoothing the isoline. Extensive studies on the Fujian province regional air temperature data demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Different types of three-step DTZD algorithms for time-varying inverse square root finding
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: On the basis of different error functions, a series of continuous-time Zhang dynamics (CTZD) models have been studied for time-varying inverse square root finding. For potential hardware implementation, the discrete-time forms of these CTZD models are further investigated. That is, by utilizing the Taylor-type difference rule to discretize the CTZD models, this paper proposes the corresponding discrete-time ZD (DTZD) algorithms to find time-varying inverse square root. Being a three-step iteration, each of the proposed DTZD algorithms is called the three-step DTZD algorithm in this paper. Theoretical results are also presented to highlight the computational properties of these three-step algorithms. With two illustrative examples, numerical results further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms in solving for time-varying inverse square root.

articleTitle: Estimation of digital image noise based on multiscale segmentation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Noise is an important factor that affects the quality of digital image, which can inhibit the useful information thus affecting the accuracy of information extraction. And signal to noise ratio is an important basis for the estimation of image information amount, so how to have a reasonable estimate of image noise and determine the signal to noise ratio with it is an important part of research into information measurement of digital images. According to the need of information measurement of digital images, a method for noise estimation based on multiscale segmentation has been put forward in this paper, which is also an improved local mean and local standard deviation noise estimation method. Both theories and experiments show that this method is more reasonable and has higher accuracy than other existing methods for image noise estimation.

articleTitle: Querying RDF graphs over partitioned indexes
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: We consider the problem of improving the query response time over a large-scale RDF collection. Existing methods need to maintain either all intermediate results or all graph structured data, which result in efficiency problems for complex queries. Our main idea is to introduce a two-level processing. The first level is performed as subgraph matching over a partition-based summary graph, which output coarse-grained matched partitions in a stream fashion. Then the fine-grained joins are processed on the matched partitions and generates the final results. Our method is efficient in that it avoid processing on large SPO permutation index at query time. An extensive experimental study using benchmark and real dataset shows that the query performance of our approach outperforms existing systems by orders of magnitudes.

articleTitle: Similarity evaluation on noisy time series gene expression data using particle filter and longest common subsequence
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Correct and accurate analysis of the similarity score using noisy time series gene expression data plays important role in understanding gene level biological systems. In this study, we propose a two-step algorithm using particle filter and longest common subsequence to compute the similarity score of noisy time series gene expression data from synthetic model and microarray measurements. Specifically, an iterative algorithm is proposed where particle filter is applied to process non-Gaussian noise data and longest common subsequence(LCS) is applied to calculate the similarity score using processed data from the first step. The proposed algorithm can obtain accurate results with unknown noise statistics. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated using data from the synthetic model and experiments.

articleTitle: A scalable frequent user association mining algorithm using MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the rapid growth of data, there exists the problem of low efficiency and lack of memory for massive frequent itemset mining. From the viewpoint of social network analysis, and on the basis of current frequent itemset mining (FIM), a method to analyze user consuming records in a new scenario has been proposed. The relationship between users could be built according to consuming time, through a three-phase scanning and merging algorithm based on MapReduce which is proposed in this paper, and performance evaluation for several university cafeteria consuming datasets in Hadoop distributed processing framework is also conducted. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is suitable for large-scale frequent user association mining, and has high efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: Simplex-bat algorithm for solving system of non-linear equations
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In consideration of the fact that bat algorithm (BA) is sensitive to the initial values and simplex algorithm (SA) could often easily fall into local optimal, simplex-bat algorithm is put forward in this paper to solve systems of non-linear equations based on the respective advantages of both algorithms. Such a hybrid algorithm does not only give full play to BA's global searching ability but also make full use of SA's local searching ability. The results of simulation experiments show that this hybrid algorithm can be used to find the roots of all sorts of systems of non-linear equations with high accuracy, and moreover, with strong robustness and fast convergence rate, and therefore, it is indeed an effective method to solve system of non-linear equations.

articleTitle: Information consistency in information-centric networking
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Information-Centric Networking (ICN) has drawn much attention and many reports have been published. However, there also exist many problems in the information management of ICN. In this paper, we mainly propose an information consistency algorithm named Breadth First Search Limit Arrangement Principle (BFSLAP). We use this algorithm to establish a new network architecture which is based on ICN information consistency. We describe the way to set up the information consistency architecture in ICN. In addition, we propose an all-gram model and a T-value formula to extract the features of contents' names. Then, we classify the contents according to these features. At last, the simulation results indicate that our BFSLAP algorithm is better than the original flooding algorithm.

articleTitle: Global analysis of a dengue fever model with quarantine
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model is established to describe the dynamics of the dengue fever with quarantine measures. Firstly, we discuss the existence and the local stability of the equilibria of the model. Secondly, by constructing Lyapunov function, we gain the sufficient conditions for global stability of the equilibria.

articleTitle: Multiscale method based on spline regression for comparing multiple nonparametric curves
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: SiZer (SIgnificant ZERo crossing of the derivatives) is a powerful scale-space visualization technique for exploratory data analysis. In this paper a new version of SiZer based on regression spline is proposed for comparing multiple regression curves. The new SiZer is constructed on the basis of p-values for testing the equality of multiple regression functions at different locations and scales. Fiducial inference and regression spline are applied to gain the p-values. In addition, multiple testing adjustments are carried out to control the row-wise false discovery rate and family-wise error rate of the proposed SiZer, respectively. The new SiZer is more powerful even in the case of small sample size case due to the good properties of p-value and FDR control. Simulation results show that the new SiZer performs well compared with the existing SiZers. Finally, a real data example is carried out to illustrate its usage in applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic contraction of tensor with quantum algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In the paper, contraction of a dynamic vector (i.e., both the number and the individuals of elements in the vector are non-deterministic) in a tensor is programmed. It accumulates complete N-combinations of one element of every M-set by recursion algorithm for object-oriented programming. Here, N is dynamic, i.e., uncertain before user's programming. This algorithm has overcome the difficulty of writing loop sentences in uncertain arity, yet the complexity of computation is exponential. So a quantum algorithm is proposed for realizing the computation in an acceptable time.

articleTitle: The prediction of protein secondary structure based on auto encoder
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, a new encoding method composed of radical group encoding and position specific scoring matrix(PSSM) is proposed. The radical group encoding contains 42 features, it is formed according to amino acids composition. To combine the radical group encoding with the evolution matrix Blosum62, this will form a new encoding method. The Bayes classifier, single-layer auto encoder and stacked auto encoder with two hidden layers are used to predict the secondary structure. The auto encoder is mainly used to extract features, the single-layer auto encoder extracts 1500 features. The stacked auto encoder extracts features in two layers, in the first layer, it extracts 1500 features, in the second layer, it extracts 800 features. The accuracies will be compared. According to the comparision of the accuracies, the accuracy of stacked auto encoder is higher 1.39% than the accuracy of single-layer auto encoder. The accuracy of single-layer auto encoder is higher 1.23% than Bayes classifier.

articleTitle: Intelligent collision avoidance decision model based on geometric analysis of relative movement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Based on collected information such as course and speed of own ship and radar observations of target ship, or AIS motion state data of own ship and target ship, a mathematical model for vessel collision avoidance is constructed adopting geometry theory and geometrical analysis of relative movement. Considering MSPD (minimum safe passing distance), this decision model for vessel collision avoidance is based on measures of space collision risk DCPA (distance to closest point of approach) and time collision risk TCPA (time to closet point of approach). In this paper, three decision models of collision avoidance for own ship's course alteration, speed alteration, course and speed alteration at the same time are deducted with plane geometry analysis as tool, movement elements of own ship and target ship as computation model, and minimum safe passing distance, TCPA and DCPA as decision variables. To verify the proposed intelligent decision model, simulation results are given to show the efficiency and robustness of the model.

articleTitle: A novel linear secret sharing scheme with multiple prime moduli
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, we explore a linear secret sharing scheme based with multiple prime muduli, explore the security properties and assess the computation and space complexity. This novel secret sharing scheme enjoys both the lower computation complexity and the lower space complexity than previous schemes, which can be widely used in light-weight computation and storage devices, such as smart phones, sensors in Internet of things.

articleTitle: Population dynamic evolutionary algorithm for virtual routers running on multiprocessors system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary game model and proposes a dynamic evolutionary algorithm based on the model. We use the game model with numerous populations to analyze the dynamic selection course of the virtual routers running on multiprocessor systems, and the evolutionary equilibrium is regarded as the solution to this game. Our dynamic evolutionary algorithm is designed with the ability to make the whole system to converge at a stable state. The algorithm is equalizing on an equilibrium fixed point, in which each virtual router tries different processors, and changes the processor selection until a stable proportion distribution is formed. The experimental results show that the dynamic evolutionary approach has very fast convergence speed and is able to effectively balance loads among processors, guarantee fair usage of computing resources among virtual routers and maintain stable high-throughputs of the system.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization based two-layer SVM classification model for evaluation of maize breeding
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In the crop breeding evaluation process, breeders have to observe and record hundreds of thousands of material dates. The traditional breeding evaluation method is effective for selecting the optimal breeding materials by consideration of a lot of characters such as yield, resistance and growth period etc. But the traditional method is difficult to meet the needs of large-scale breeding. Combined with breeders on crop performance evaluation of comprehensive evaluation, the paper proposes parameter optimization based two-layer SVM classification model. The model uses the radial basis function as the kernel function, and uses the method of cross validation to train the sample data several times to obtain the optimal penalty coefficient C and the kernel function parameter g. In the first layer classification model, the breeding trait data is divided into three parts: high yield, stable yield and disease resistance, and the corresponding classification results are obtained. In the second layer model, the first layer classification results are used as the characteristic attribute; being input to the model to get the final category. In order to verify the effect of the model, the paper uses k-neighborhood, decision tree, and random forest and Naive Bayesian classifier as control. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the proposed two-layer classification optimization model is 91.523%, is more than other classifiers. So, the parameter optimization based two-layer SVM classification model is suitable for breeding evaluation technology.

articleTitle: Vehicle type recognition based on increasing hierarchical feature convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and reduce convergence rate for vehicle type recognition, this paper proposes a novel method based on IHFCNN (Increasing Hierarchical Feature Convolutional Neural Networks). Firstly, utilizing the characteristics of biological vision, a new network layer based on classical convolutional neural network is presented to simulate the hierarchical processing of information. Secondly, features are extracted from different layers, and then a fully-connected layer is connected. Finally, center loss is introduced to output layer, and Softmax classifier is applied for vehicle type recognition. The experimental results show that, compared with the classic networks as AlexNet, GoogLeNet and VGG16, the proposed method reduces the number of convergent iterations significantly and improves the recognition accuracy up to 97.78% in the database with 321678 training images and 8490 for testing in real application scenarios.

articleTitle: A novel multi-objective genetic algorithm for the QoS based multicast routing and wavelength allocation problem in WDM network
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: An archive based multi-objective genetic algorithm is proposed for the QoS based multicast routing and wavelength allocation problem (MRWA) is proposed. To not lose promising candidates and improve the algorithm efficiency, an external archive is introduced and used to preserve the promising candidates and form the next generation population. To increase the population diversity, a Pareto local search process is used to make a further exploitation for the new offspring generated by the mutation process. The selection mechanism is redesigned to intensify the exploration of promising areas. The proposed algorithm is evaluated on a set of different scale test problems and compared with some excellent related algorithms. The experimental results reveal very encouraging results in terms of the solution quality.

articleTitle: Fusion algorithms for multispectral and panchromatic image based on wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Multispectral image includes abundant spectral information, Panchromatic image has better space resolution, so fusion algorithm based wavelet transformation has advantage on realizing fusion for two kinds of images in order to increase high space resolution information of panchromatic image into multispectral image. In this paper, author realizes the aim by designing different fusion rules and controlling decomposing strategy of wavelet transformation. Finally, the author achieves experiments of different fusion schemes, and analyzes experiment results on the basis of subjective and objective evaluation index detailedly, and gives specific conclusion for advantages and disadvantages of different fusion schemes, which show rationality of designing different fusion rules and decomposing strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis on the performance of several data association algorithms using Doppler information
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Concerning the multi-target tracking problems of multiple-frequency CW radar system, several improved Bayes algorithms by using target radial velocity information are proposed in this paper. In order to clearly figure out the differences in the tracking performances, including the tracking precision and the real-time quality, of these improved and conventional algorithms, the detailed analysis on the performances of these algorithms in the same conditions are presented. First, the association method of each algorithm is described briefly. Then, the tracking model is established. Finally, the simulations obtained from a typical way of multi-target tracking are used, and the tracking performance of these algorithms is analyzed comprehensively in all aspects according to the simulation results.

articleTitle: Fast variable-frame-rate decoding of speech recognition based on deep neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNN) have recently shown impressive performance as acoustic models for large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (LVCSR) tasks. Typically, the frame shift of the output of neural networks is much shorter than the average length of the modeling units, so the posterior vectors of neighbouring frames are likely to be similar. The similarity, together with the better discrimination of neural networks than typical acoustic models, shows a possibility of removing frames of neural network outputs according to the distance of posterior vectors. Then, the computation costs of beam searching can be effectively reduced. Based on that, the paper introduces a novel variable-frame-rate decoding approach based on neural network computation that accelerates the beam searching for speech recognition with minor loss of accuracy. By computing the distances of posterior vectors and removing frames with a posterior vector similar to the previous frame, the approach can make use of redundant information between frames and do a much quicker beam searching. Experiments on LVCSR tasks show a 2.4-times speed up of decoding compared to the typical framewise decoding implementation.

articleTitle: Bus scheduling method based on image texture and color analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Public transport vehicle scheduling system plays a very important role in relieving urban traffic pressure, and it's now still a difficult problem. In order to solve the problem effectively, we propose a bus scheduling method based on video processing algorithm in this paper. Firstly, we decode the H264 bare stream which receive from the bus in real-time, and according to the prior knowledge, a certain number of training samples with different density levels were collected, and then extract the improved gray-level co-occurrence matrix and color entropy features of training samples to train the classifier model. Finally, crowd density estimation result can get by processing the real time vehicle video using the trained model. Combined the result of density estimation with vehicle status information, we can realize the vehicle scheduling effectively.

articleTitle: Deeply learned electrocardiogram representations are robust
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper proposes a discriminative feature representation for electrocardiogram (ECG) identification. A new architecture based on deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), auto-feature extractor, is designed for one-dimensional ECG signals to extract deep features efficiently. The deep feature performs well for ECG identification without restriction on classifier and ECG status. The method achieves 98.49% accuracy for different state ECG signals from four public ECG databases and a private ECG database. The experiments demonstrate that the deep features extracted using the auto-feature extractor are discriminative and robust in real applications.

articleTitle: Broadband power pattern synthesis of arbitrary arrays with mutual coupling
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: A broadband power pattern synthesis technique for arbitrary array, taking the mutual coupling (MC) into account, is proposed based on a weighted L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm criterion. The MC effect is considered by introducing a MC matrix, and can be compensated if an accurate MC matrix is available. Firstly the non-convex objective function is transformed into a linear one with an auxiliary function. A technique which jointly performs the phases and weighting functions correction is applied to control the pattern shape. For a given array, the MC matrix is calculated only once since it only depends on the radiating characteristics of the elements, the geometries of array and also on frequency. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the water environmental quality monitoring system based on big data
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: To realize the comprehensive scientific decision-making of ecological environment, a hybrid storage structure based on a combination of big data technology and traditional database is designed. First, HBase has high expansibility and reliability to the data storage capacity in big environmental monitoring data. Second, relational database MySql provides powerful SQL query language and data analysis capabilities, which can provide a real time statistical analysis and multi dimension display on recent environmental quality monitoring data. Given method can effectively improve the data storage size and query speed, compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: Qualitative configuration based on generality data in ranch in three-river headwaters region
publicationTitle: 2017 13th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Three-River Headwaters Region is the complex ecosystem with typical characteristics of alpine grass land. Livestock husbandry is the main industry of yak husbandry. In recent years, with the continuous advance of industry 4.0, the data in the alpine animal husbandry has the problems of low standardization and low clustering.
